Local policy (OBS-4):
- Runtime UI uses TreeView + SpanCard closure only.
- DetailsView / TraceViewer / TraceList are present in the vendor tree for provenance
  but excluded from TypeScript compilation (npm 0.0.9 lacks newer DetailsView APIs such as
  RunErrorEntry; TheAllTour also supplies its own sanitized details panel).
- shared.ts SPAN_CATEGORY_CONFIG labels remapped for TheAllTour marketing kinds
  (AGENT / ORCHESTRATION / DETERMINISTIC / VALIDATION / HUMAN BOUNDARY / TOOL).
